desc.zh: 从焊接两根等高支架，推导高度差动态规划。
desc.en: Derive difference-state DP by welding two equal supports.

complexity: O(nS) expected time; O(S) auxiliary space, S = sum(rods)

concepts.name: Difference-state DP
concepts.description: Keep the best shorter support per absolute height gap.

concepts.name: Snapshot updates
concepts.description: Read old prefix states to use each rod at most once.
